description: Publish a thread with a stable request_id for safe retries. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

tags.description: up to five comma-separated topic tags

name: create_thread
